# Agentic Map Tracing
> Agent-native skills for reasoning-driven geospatial interpretation and editable CAD/GIS tracing. Agent perception and domain reasoning choose boundaries; helpers execute deterministic geometry and evidence work.

- [Agent entry](AGENTS.md)
- [Road skill](skills/satellite-road-edge-tracing/SKILL.md)
- [Install/discover](docs/SKILL-DISCOVERY.md)
- [Method](docs/interpretation-method.md)
- [Correction cases](docs/correction-cases.md)
- [Validation](docs/validation.md)
- [Contribute under MIT](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Optional AutoCAD backend](https://github.com/capskov/cad-agent-foundation)

Only the road module is implemented. No segmentation weights, backend connector, survey accuracy or cross-model equivalence is implied.
